Type: lamp
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Globe Stick Table Lamp, 19"H, Pink Terrazzo
Colors: Pink
This table lamp is sleek and subtle in design, the slim metal upright rising from a solid, sturdy cylindrical base to end in a globe shade that will shed diffused light. As much sculpture as lamp, this piece will add a pop of interest to a side table or desk. This table lamp is made out of metal, terrazzo, and acrylic. This table lamp will help light your living space, providing a warm ambiance. The stylish combination of metal and terrazzo gives this lamp structural appeal. 6"W x 6"D x 19"H Simple assembly in 15-30 minutes This lamp comes with a bulb and is rated for indoor use.
